day-aligned releaseStartTime_ is stored into _releaseStartTime

msg.sender becomes the initial owner through _msgSender()

constructor requires _releaseEndTime to be greater than block.timestamp

onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable as the reference authority
terminate() is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier
isNotTerminated reads the _isTerminated state flag
terminate() is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier
owner() returns the _owner state variable
token() returns the _token state variable
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable

releasedBalance multiplies _totalBenefit by the elapsed fraction

released amount depends on the miner-controlled block.timestamp

local totalDays is computed inside releasedBalance

owner() is the recipient of the unreleased balance transfer
